rect.title: Email/password login (optional Google login: not started)

Step 1: Accounts, cars, odometer. Done (MVP1-A, B and C signed off), apart from the gaps marked below. Settings signed off: language, theme and currency (SET-1), and km or miles (SET-2).
Step 2: Maintenance tasks, templates, Reset. Done (MVP2-A, B and C signed off).

Step 3: Service history with costs MVP3-A, B, C and D signed off (history list, record a past service with parts and labour, edit everything including date, odometer and tasks, delete, filter and search on the Service history page), and LOW-1. Missing: attachments (waits for Cloudflare R2).

Step 4: Dashboard with due and overdue status MVP4-A signed off (the dashboard on /: overdue and due-soon counts, this month's spend linking to the history, each car's next 3 tasks with Mark done and Undo, quick odometer entry). LOW-2 signed off. Start a checklist signed off with MVP5-B.

Step 5: Checklists, then tires, then reports and notifications MVP5-A, MVP5-B and MVP5-C signed off (your own checklists; attach them to a car with a schedule, run them with flags, run history, Start a checklist on the dashboard; a flagged item becomes a to-do on the car). MVP5-D and MVP5-E signed off (tire sets, mount and swap, km per set, storage notes, pressure and tread checks, rotations). LOW-4 (small fixes) signed off. RPT-1 signed off (the Reports page: costs per car, category, month and year, cost per km, total cost of ownership). RPT-2 signed off (bar charts per month and per category). RPT-3 signed off (export to CSV and PDF). MVP5-C, LOW-3, MVP5-D, MVP5-E, LOW-4, RPT-1, RPT-2 and RPT-3 were not checked in a browser (the ui-tester is stopped). Missing: photos on runs, and notifications. LOW-5 (small fixes) is next, then notifications.
Before going online: SEC-1 (limit login attempts, account lockout, constant-time login). Signed off.
Checklist templates
Items: checkbox, number or text (numbers with a unit and an allowed range)
Schedule by km, by time, or manual only
Run a checklist: tick items, add notes or photos, flag issues. Missing: photos, which need Cloudflare R2.
Failed items create a to-do or a maintenance task (a to-do, as decided; not checked in a browser)
Run history per car
Create a Cloudflare R2 bucket and access key. This blocks car photos and receipts.

Review the delegated decisions in docs/decisions.md, especially the 12 starter task intervals, the task status rules (when a task counts as "Due soon" or "Overdue"), the Reset and Undo rules (a one-tap reset counts as DIY; Undo only for the latest reset of a task), the settings rules (changing the currency does not convert old amounts; only ILS, USD, EUR and GBP), the km/miles rules (converted template intervals such as 6,214 mi rather than round mile values; the unit is not asked at sign-up; the Hebrew label "קילומטראז׳" kept in miles), the service history rules (undone records are hidden; an old service never moves a task's last done backwards; Undo works on any record, in any order; a corrected later-dated service at a lower odometer moves last done to that lower reading), the line item rules (the total becomes the sum of the items whenever there are items), the search rules (a separate Service history page for all cars, read-only, with edit and delete staying on the car page; the search doesn't look in task names), and the edit rules for MVP3-D (changing a service's date, odometer or tasks moves the car's odometer and the tasks' last done; a service can't be moved to another car), two readings on the same day ordered by when they were saved (ordering by value was tried and reverted), and the dashboard rules (home page /; this month's spend includes archived cars so it matches the Service history page; one-tap Mark done without cost or notes; a task moves down its card after Mark done because cards follow urgency), the checklist rules (your own checklists only, no ready-made ones for now; a checklist can be "manual only" with no schedule, even though the spec's data rules ask for an interval; units on number items are free text and not converted; a checklist is due soon at 10% of its interval left, with no setting; Not OK and a number outside its range are flagged automatically; runs can be deleted but not edited; due checklists are not counted in the dashboard's Overdue and Due soon numbers; actions hidden on archived cars and on turned-off checklists; a 30-day schedule reads "Every 1 month"), and the to-do rules for MVP5-C (a flagged checklist item becomes a to-do you create with one tap, not automatically and not a maintenance task, because a maintenance task can't say "fix this now"), and the LOW-3 choices (dates before 1900 rejected; a number sent instead of a name for a choice field is rejected; the old browser QA scripts deleted), and the tire rules for MVP5-D (tire sets on a new Tires page; mounting a set on a car that has one is a swap; mounting and unmounting don't add an odometer reading; a full purchase date rather than a year; deleting a set deletes its history), and the MVP5-E tire check rules (pressure in bar only, also for miles users; no low-tread warning yet; one check per set per day; a rotation is a dated note and does not reset a maintenance task; a check is stored as one dated header with a row per wheel, slightly different from the spec's data model), and the Hebrew form of address (singular, לך and שלך, everywhere).

Tell us when the ui-tester (browser QA) may run again. You stopped it; MVP5-C, LOW-3, MVP5-D, MVP5-E, LOW-4, RPT-1, RPT-2 and RPT-3 shipped without a browser check, and LOW-5 will too until you say so.

Check the report rules (RPT-1): a service on several categories is split equally between them; km driven counts from the car's first odometer reading; total cost of ownership is purchase price plus services (no fuel, no tire purchases). And the Hebrew name for it: "עלות בעלות כוללת" is used now; say if you prefer another term. Also the export plan (RPT-3): the CSV lists the service records (not the summary tables), and the PDF is made with the browser's "Save as PDF" in the print dialog rather than a PDF library. When you next use Reports, open one exported CSV in Excel and try "Print or save as PDF" once; no agent can check either.

Decide whether to clear the test users from your local database. scripts/cleanup-test-users.sql deletes only accounts with machine-generated test emails (from the browser tests, test scripts and agents, such as ui-...@onlycars.test and qa+...@example.com; 1,056 of the 1,153 accounts when counted, more since) and all their data. It never matches your own accounts. The RPT-1 test users (rpt1-…, ui-rpt-…, probe-rpt-…) may not be covered yet; that is checked in LOW-5. Run the dry run first; it lists the accounts and changes nothing: sqlcmd -S "(localdb)\MSSQLLocalDB" -d OnlyCars -E -b -v DryRun=1 -i scripts/cleanup-test-users.sql (the database is OnlyCars, from src/OnlyCars.Api/appsettings.json). -v DryRun=0 deletes. Nobody has run it, not even the dry run.
Create an Azure account, when it's time to deploy. You said not yet, so no deployment work is planned until you say so.
Task name and category
Interval by km, by time, or both (whichever comes first)
Starter template library, fully editable (12 templates; the owner should review their intervals)
Custom tasks per car
Turn a task off without deleting it
Date, odometer, shop or DIY, total cost, notes (one record can cover several tasks)
Line items: part, brand, part number, quantity, unit cost, labour (total is the sum of the items)
Attachments: receipt photos, PDFs, invoices
Filter and search by car, task, date or shop (Service history page, all cars, filters kept in the link)
Edit and delete past records (everything on a record, including date, odometer and tasks; the car's odometer and the tasks' last done follow)
Tire sets: brand, model, size, season, purchase year (a full purchase date), DOT code
Which set is on which car, with mount and unmount dates
Km driven per set, calculated automatically
Pressure log, tread depth log, rotation tracking (pressure in bar only)
Storage notes for the off-season set
Add, edit and archive cars, keeping their history
Fields: nickname, make, model, year, VIN, plate, fuel type, purchase date, photo. Missing: photo upload, which needs Cloudflare R2 set up.
Current odometer, with a history of readings, which you can edit and delete
Multiple cars per account
Manual odometer updates with a quick-entry button (on the car page and on each dashboard card)
Auto-log the odometer when a service is recorded (Mark done and the Record a service form)
Average km/day, used to predict due dates. Calculated and shown. Not used for predictions yet (optional, later).
Km/miles unit, and a currency per user (both in Settings; every distance on screen is converted)
Remaining km and days, a progress bar, and status: OK, Due soon, Overdue
Reset / Mark as done (records odometer and date, restarts the countdown, creates a history entry with optional cost and notes)
Undo for accidental resets (right after the reset, and any record from the service history)
Configurable "due soon" threshold (percent, 1 to 50)
Cost per car, per category, per month and per year (Reports page; a service on several categories is split equally; not checked in a browser)
Cost per km and total cost of ownership (per mile for miles users; TCO is purchase price plus services; not checked in a browser)
Charts: spending over time, cost by category (bars per month and per category on the Reports page; right to left in Hebrew; not checked in a browser)
Export to CSV and PDF (a CSV of the service records for the chosen year and car, and a PDF from the browser's print dialog; not checked in a browser, and nobody has opened the CSV in Excel yet)
Email (and optional push) when a task is due soon or overdue
Non-mileage reminders: insurance, inspection, registration, licence
Snooze, and a configurable lead time
All cars at a glance, next due items sorted by urgency
Overdue count and monthly spend summary (links to the Service history for the same month)
Quick actions: update odometer, reset a task, start a checklist
